scope: Fixed-master40 actual-media targeted visual review only. Automatic every-frame metrics are maintained separately by root. No full-960 or every-frame visual acceptance claim.
equipment_and_arm_scope: No visible equipment replacement or duplicate arms in inspected samples, where explicitly marked.
remaining_visual_issue: Facial opacity crossfade can retain semi-transparent original iris/eye lines. Fixed equipment provenance is not full facial/joint visual certification.
